title: OpenAI Adds Next-Message Suggestions to Codex Pro
summary:
Analysis of a user's personal communication style and conversation history now powers a new beta feature in the Codex desktop app. The tool, known as 'composer predictions,' allows Pro users to automatically generate their next response for local tasks by pressing the Tab key to accept suggested text. The feature can be toggled off within the application settings.

OpenAI is providing the predictions at no extra cost during the beta phase, noting that the tool was one of the most popular features tested internally. Representative Sharif Shameem stated that the company does not plan to train these predictions using a user's laod of Codex usage data, and this privacy policy will remain after the testing period concludes.
